queue.title: ATRI: The top underutilized telematics that can benefit truckers
queue.excerpt: Nearly one in three carriers don’t integrate telematics data with their TMS, increasing the risk of unexpected downtime.

queue.title: U.S. plans 2-month extension to shipping-fee truce with China
queue.excerpt: If approved, the Office of the United States Trade Representative’s proposal will prolong a bilateral truce that was set to expire in early November until Jan. 9.
